Plate 01 · validate

Check a declaration.

Paste a document, or give a live URL and we will fetch it and report what it is actually served as. A declaration served as text/html is a real failure, and it is the one a parked domain produces.

structure, invariant

transport, media type

skill/scripts/validate_vgp.py in the repository is canonical and runs offline with no dependencies. This page reports the same invariants so you can check a live site without a toolchain.

Verified Giving Protocol 0.1 · draft Issued by Whole Whale MIT licensed Last updated 2026-08-27 Repository

VGP has no standards-body status and no IANA registration. It is a 0.1 draft. It asserts nothing about organisations that have not published a declaration, and a destination absent from a declaration is not thereby illegitimate.
